option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> flat CSR
helps_prd_outcomes: clean OLTP/OLAP split; simple published snapshot read path; preserves current seed
known_blockers: graph catalog, sidecars, and mutate/write semantics are not solved by topology alone
required_capabilities: snapshot open/query; catalog identity; build reproducibility
dominant_ram_risks: per-node algorithm state and build scratch can exceed heap-only intuition
next_falsifier: complete one more traced family besides PageRank and show it still fits without cells

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> flat CSR plus sidecars
helps_prd_outcomes: covers semantics outside topology: labels, types, weights, properties, results
known_blockers: sidecar cataloging, writeback, and holistic estimates still need explicit design
required_capabilities: graph project/list; PageRank weighted modes; result sidecars
dominant_ram_risks: sidecar duplication and page-cache blow-up if columns are over-materialized
next_falsifier: find a required GDS family that needs mutable topology instead of topology plus sidecars

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> cellular CSR snapshots
helps_prd_outcomes: may help locality, bounded rebuilds, and packaging
known_blockers: no first-party evidence yet that cells are required for the traced surface
required_capabilities: locality-heavy workloads; bounded rebuild; optional local compaction
dominant_ram_risks: duplicated metadata, boundary overhead, cache churn if partitioning is poor
next_falsifier: show that flat global CSR plus sidecars cannot honestly meet a representative GDS family or locality budget

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> hybrid flat plus cellular publication
helps_prd_outcomes: preserves flat global scans while allowing locality packaging
known_blockers: duplicates topology unless tightly justified; ops complexity rises
required_capabilities: same as B plus selective locality packaging
dominant_ram_risks: duplicate topology, duplicate page-cache competition, publication complexity
next_falsifier: prove cells matter for one high-value family without breaking global scan economics

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> multi-generation snapshot catalog
helps_prd_outcomes: required for watermarks, rollback, and atomic publication
known_blockers: active-pointer, retention, reader-pinning, and restart-recovery design still missing
required_capabilities: named graph identity; generation swap; watermark reporting
dominant_ram_risks: catalog metadata is small, but poor retention can silently multiply disk and cache pressure
next_falsifier: find a credible published-snapshot design that does not need generation or watermark semantics

option_summary: append-only receipt log only
helps_prd_outcomes: durable ingress; replayability
known_blockers: weak metadata, weak publication state, weak dedupe/dictionary support
required_capabilities: receipt replay only
dominant_ram_risks: rebuild jobs still need side metadata somewhere else
next_falsifier: show a full snapshot compiler can operate reproducibly from only a receipt log

option_summary: embedded transactional metadata store only
helps_prd_outcomes: catalog metadata; durable state; reader pinning
known_blockers: poor fit for high-volume append receipt ingress by itself
required_capabilities: generation metadata; dictionaries; validation state
dominant_ram_risks: in-place growth and internal buffering can hide scratch costs
next_falsifier: show ingest and replay throughput are good enough without a separate append log

option_summary: append-only receipt log plus embedded transactional metadata/fact store
helps_prd_outcomes: matches ingress, durable state, publish discipline, replay, validation, and crash recovery
known_blockers: more moving parts than a single engine
required_capabilities: receipt log; durable facts; generation metadata; validation reports
dominant_ram_risks: two stores mean duplication if fact retention is not bounded
next_falsifier: a later simpler single-store design proves equally clear and lower-RAM

option_summary: full LSM or delta-serving layer queried by OLAP users
helps_prd_outcomes: high freshness potential
known_blockers: violates PRD boundary, invites hidden RAM, query-time reconciliation, and serving-plane confusion
required_capabilities: live merge reads; tombstones; freshness overlays
dominant_ram_risks: memtables, compaction backlog, page cache, and query-time merge state
next_falsifier: PRD later explicitly allows OLAP queries to read from a live mutable middle layer

option_summary: per-generation snapshot payload only, no active catalog
helps_prd_outcomes: preserves the current simple file payload
known_blockers: no active pointer, weak rollback, weak retention semantics
required_capabilities: none beyond file emission
dominant_ram_risks: low metadata RAM, but high correctness ambiguity
next_falsifier: prove readers can never race publication or cleanup without a catalog

option_summary: active catalog file pointing to immutable generation payloads
helps_prd_outcomes: supports watermark reporting, publish/swap, rollback, and retention
known_blockers: needs explicit state machine and durability order
required_capabilities: active pointer; staged states; retained floor
dominant_ram_risks: metadata RAM is tiny; retained generations dominate disk/cache pressure
next_falsifier: a simpler scheme matches the same correctness guarantees

option_summary: timestamp- or directory-scan-based latest-generation discovery
helps_prd_outcomes: very simple operationally
known_blockers: ambiguous visibility, weak rollback semantics, weak validation boundary
required_capabilities: filesystem conventions only
dominant_ram_risks: low metadata RAM but high correctness risk
next_falsifier: a formal proof or implementation spike shows scans are safe and race-free

option_summary: Ladybug-style immutable Parquet plus CSR graph snapshots
helps_prd_outcomes: published snapshots, sidecars, analytical scans, build/publish discipline
known_blockers: may be too columnar-heavy if copied literally
required_capabilities: none specified in batch table
dominant_ram_risks: decode and page-cache behavior on cold scans
next_falsifier: compare direct CSR binaries versus Parquet-packaged topology on the same walk and PageRank cases

option_summary: Kuzu-style compact embedded graph engine ideas
helps_prd_outcomes: low-RAM graph engine, CSR adjacency, vectorized/factorized execution, stats-aware planner
known_blockers: live engine complexity may exceed v003’s immediate need
required_capabilities: none specified in batch table
dominant_ram_risks: executor state and planner complexity
next_falsifier: deeper scan of storage-manager and buffer behavior reveals hidden resident-state costs

option_summary: Memgraph-like in-memory Cypher plus big algorithm catalog
helps_prd_outcomes: compatibility and algorithm-surface awareness
known_blockers: conflicts with RAM-first premise
required_capabilities: none specified in batch table
dominant_ram_risks: whole-graph resident memory
next_falsifier: product direction changes away from 50GB-on-8GB feasibility

option_summary: FalkorDB-style sparse-matrix substrate
helps_prd_outcomes: selected linear-algebra-friendly families
known_blockers: poor fit for universal GDS and Neo4j-like storage story
required_capabilities: none specified in batch table
dominant_ram_risks: matrix materialization and extra substrate complexity
next_falsifier: kernel tracing shows major target families map cleanly to sparse algebra with lower RAM

option_summary: AGE-style PostgreSQL extension hybrid
helps_prd_outcomes: catalog/publication semantics and SQL/Cypher coexistence caution
known_blockers: not a RAM-first OLAP template and not a Neo4j OLTP clone
required_capabilities: none specified in batch table
dominant_ram_risks: relational storage overhead and serving-plane complexity
next_falsifier: control-plane lessons turn out essential enough to justify deeper adoption

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> flat CSR only
helps_prd_outcomes: simple published snapshot path and preserved topology oracle
known_blockers: property plane, artifact plane, projection catalog, and runtime workspace remain unsolved
required_capabilities: typed sidecars, result/model artifacts, catalog identity, honest estimator discipline
dominant_ram_risks: hidden sidecar duplication and ad hoc scratch outside the topology plan
next_falsifier: prove hard families, catalog semantics, and estimator classes fit honestly without sidecars, artifacts, or runtime workspaces

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> flat CSR plus sidecars plus artifact plane
helps_prd_outcomes: matches long-tail GDS support tiers without multiplying durable graph layouts
known_blockers: still needs disciplined catalog, runtime workspace, spill gates, and writeback semantics
required_capabilities: canonical adjacency, typed property plane, result/model artifacts, projection catalog
dominant_ram_risks: runtime workspace and artifact state can still exceed budgets if estimators are weak
next_falsifier: show a required family that honestly demands a different durable graph topology rather than stronger support planes

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> cellular CSR snapshots
helps_prd_outcomes: may still help locality, bounded rebuilds, and dirty-region publication
known_blockers: not forced by representative, hard-family, or long-tail GDS evidence
required_capabilities: locality packaging, dirty-region compaction, optional bounded rebuild
dominant_ram_risks: boundary metadata, duplicate cache pressure, and partitioning overhead
next_falsifier: prove a high-value family or workload cannot stay honest on canonical flat publication plus support planes

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> hybrid flat plus cellular publication
helps_prd_outcomes: preserves canonical global scans while leaving room for later locality packaging
known_blockers: duplicates topology and operational complexity unless cells earn their place
required_capabilities: same as B plus locality-specific publication semantics
dominant_ram_risks: duplicate topology, duplicate page-cache competition, and recovery complexity
next_falsifier: show repeated measured wins from cells that outweigh duplicate-layout costs

option_summary: Neo4j OLTP -> Build Store -> multi-generation snapshot catalog
helps_prd_outcomes: remains required for graph identity, publication, rollback, retention, and estimator reporting
known_blockers: still needs concrete implementation schema and recovery tests
required_capabilities: active generation pointer, watermark identity, retention floor
dominant_ram_risks: retained generations and stale artifacts can silently multiply disk/cache pressure
next_falsifier: prove a simpler no-catalog publication scheme can preserve the same safety and identity semantics
